newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to hold OFZ bond trading on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Russia to hold OFZ bond trading on Wednesday.

text.p: Russia's central bank will hold an extraordinary OFZ bond trading session on Wednesday so that banks can reinvest funds from bonds the Finance Ministry is redeeming early, a central bank official said on Tuesday.
Russia is repaying on a voluntary basis tax-liable OFZ coupon-bearing bonds, which have been discontinued. Russia now issues tax-liable bonds.

The Finance Ministry will repay series 24008 bonds, and banks will be able to buy series 24011, 24012, 24013, 24014 and 24015 OFZ bonds, central bank securities department head Alexei Drugov told Reuters.
Banks will not be able to trade among themselves at the extra session.
Russia does not usually hold trading sessions on Wednesdays, when auctions take place.
Drugov said banks were to bid at the average price in secondary trading for series 24011, 24012, 24013 and 24014 bonds and at the average price of Wednesday's auction on series 24015 bonds.
The trading will take place after 1300 GMT, he said.
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry will offer to repay the entire series 24008 OFZ bonds, a total 4.81 trillion roubles.
Calculation of coupons of the bonds being redeemed has been complicated by the discontinuation of the instrument on which coupon rates are based, tax-liable GKO discount T-bills.
